text:
samir khan: Hi team, just unboxed my corp M2 Air. Tried to finish setup and Kandji says enrollment failed with Activation Lock. It asked me to sign in with the Apple ID that was used during ABM enrollment. I never set one. Stuck on "This device is linked to an Apple ID" screen. Anyone seen this?

lisa - IT: Ugh, welcome and congrats. This usually happens when the device was assigned in Apple Business Manager before we cleared the previous buyers association. @apple-config-bot can you check the ABM record for serial C02M2AB12345?

apple-config-bot: Queried ABM: serial C02M2AB12345 -> assigned to DEP profile "Redwood - default" but has activation_lock: true and owned_by: reseller_temp_47. Opening case APPLE-ABM-6312. Please provide proof of purchase if reseller transfer needed.

samir khan: Screenshot attached: <activation-screen.png>. I don't have reseller docs, I was sent the laptop by hiring coordinator.

lisa - IT: Filing internal support request. @it-help-bot opening ticket INC-2026-21800 for ABM transfer. Samir, can you DM me the packing slip or the email thread that confirmed shipment? If not, we can ask procurement.

it-help-bot: Ticket INC-2026-21800 created. Recommended steps: 1) collect order number or procurement email, 2) run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial` and paste output, 3) do NOT try to bypass activation lock.

samir khan: Serial: C02M2AB12345. I have the purchase confirmation email from procurement forwarded by @hiring-coordinator. I DM'd it to @lisa - IT.

oliver - security: Heads up: if a previous owners Apple ID is still attached that means Activation Lock is active in ABM. Procurement usually coordinates a transfer with the reseller or Apple. We should avoid using temporary admin workarounds here.

lisa - IT: Got the DM. I'll escalate to procurement and request a reseller transfer. Meanwhile, you can use a loaner for the day. @samir khan do you need SSH/Homebrew today or can you wait until we clear ABM?

samir khan: Need to run a quick devenv setup for interviews later. Loaner would be great. Thanks.

it-help-bot: Loaner request submitted: LOAN-2026-6701. Please pick up at HQ front desk; badge will be preauthorized.

lisa - IT: Procurement replied to my escalation and sent reseller invoice. Apple confirmed transfer will complete in 1-2 business days. I'll update this thread when ABM shows activation_lock: false.

apple-config-bot: ABM update: activation_lock flag cleared at 2026-03-24T15:12Z. Kandji device now re-enrolling.

samir khan: Rebooted, Kandji prompted for enrollment and finished. FileVault starting. Thanks everyone!

lisa - IT: Welcome aboard @samir khan. Keep the loaner until your device is fully encrypted and shows up in Kandji as "Enrolled". Return instructions in LOAN-2026-6701.

oliver - security: Small reminder: once enrolled, confirm FileVault escrow shows in Kandji and add device to your Okta device list.

samir khan: Done, FileVault escrow good. Adding intro in #general now :wave:
